dedupe_keys.name: greentravel five city active mobility ppgis points

description: The GREENTRAVEL public participation GIS deposit contains mapped experiences of everyday walking and cycling environments in five European urban regions. The study surveyed residents in the Helsinki metropolitan area, Greater Copenhagen, Greater London, Greater Munich and Las Palmas de Gran Canaria during winter 2023–2024. Respondents marked places associated with pleasant or unpleasant active travel and street greenery. Zenodo lists a public spatial-data ZIP and survey document under CC BY 4.0; the article also has two nonspatial CSV supplements without separate repository addresses. City respondent counts range from 582 in Las Palmas to 1,225 in Copenhagen. Coverage reflects people who completed the online survey, not a full population register or measured pedestrian counts. Self-selection, recall and differing urban contexts limit comparisons between cities. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is assigning perceived route attractiveness in active-mobility scenarios. model-propensity-to-cycle-tool is a related cycling planning model, but the survey points were not linked to its network. No ZIP or questionnaire PDF was downloaded.
